I don't think it would be controversial to say that OBS is the single best screen recording and live streaming software there is. I've been using it for over two years, and I will keep using it for many more to come.

Though I prefer standalone utility software, having the option to use it through Steam is great for those who want it.

Be it streaming, recording lets plays, or just having a replay buffer open to make sure I don't miss out on any clip-worthy moments, OBS is one of the single most useful pieces of software I've ever used.
